findings.subject: Preserve current and incoming KB navigation
findings.detail: All three comparisons produce conflicts in kb/index.md and kb/records/index.md. Reconcile links to retain current releases and incoming research, then regenerate derived catalogues and indexes. Do not accept one whole side.

findings.subject: Preserve source IDs and evidence
findings.detail: PR 24 and PR 33 comparisons also conflict in kb/research/references/data/source-catalog.json. Combine source records by stable ID, inspect any same-ID differences and rerun all research validators after integration. Current website citations and incoming research references both matter.

findings.subject: Research structure is not editorial acceptance
findings.detail: All 17 available validator runs pass on isolated snapshots. These checks do not validate every claim, translation, source licence or live URL; the 342-file PR 24 received a bounded sample review, not line-by-line factual certification.

findings.subject: Community tourism and homestay counts
findings.detail: PR 33 distinguishes 2025–26 partial-year observations from complete years, programme-wide tourism from location-specific outcomes, and allocation rules from actual wages. Preserve those qualifications. The 17-versus-176 provisional-certificate conflict is unresolved; neither is a verified operating-homestay total.

findings.subject: Reuse map and naming proposal
findings.detail: PR 22 maps prior research and queues reuse; PR 24 expands candidates and proposes Utkal naming consistency with exceptions for historical sources. Those AGENTS changes are reviewed proposals here, not adopted instructions.

sampled_records: PR 22: kb/records/research-reuse-audit-2026-10-01.json, reuse query and validation tools, research map structure.
PR 24: kb/records/homestay-policy-2026-10-01.json, source-catalog and collection validation, naming and workflow diffs.
PR 33: kb/records/community-tourism-2026-10-01.json, ecotourism-livelihoods dataset and statistics validator changes.
recommended_next_steps: Reconcile PR 22 with current main, regenerate indexes, run current full validation and obtain Founder approval for its exact result.
After PR 22 lands, update PR 24 against the new main; preserve source-catalog additions from both lines, regenerate derived data, rerun validation and obtain review.
Then update PR 33 against the integrated main and repeat checks. Keep research adoption distinct from selecting claims for the website.
limitations: No independent historian, native-language reader or specialist review.
Sources sampled through repository captures were not independently retrieved anew in this batch.
PR 22 has a historical successful CI run; PR 24 and PR 33 had no check runs on their stacked bases. Workflow targets main; run current validation on each integrated candidate.
Read-only merge comparison does not establish that subsequent sequential merges will have identical conflicts.
